title: Observability: successful ioctl_init logs nothing about which provider was selected
description: ioctl_init() in src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c emits no log on successful session creation. When a user calls INIT with an empty provider string (any-provider lookup), there is no dmesg record of which provider was selected. A support engineer examining a post-mortem log cannot determine post-hoc which provider handled a given session without capturing the GET_STATE ioctl result while the fd was open. The selected provider name is available at line 672 (strscpy into state->provider_name). Fix: emit pr_debug at session creation success including algo and resolved provider name, allowing dynamic debug to surface this without production log noise.
